factual_claims.claim: The global market for AI-driven recruitment and hiring technology experienced significant growth in the years leading up to 2022.
President Joe Biden issued an executive order on October 30, 2023, imposing mandates on federal agencies' use of AI.
The Digital Services Act (DSA) in Europe entered into force in February 2024.
The European Parliament adopted the AI Act in March 2024.
New York City Local Law 144, which requires bias audits for AI hiring tools, became effective in July 2023.
Only 19 audits linked to NYC Local Law 144 were published in the first 6 months after its entry into force.
The applicant pool for the study consisted of 1,373 applications to K-12 teaching positions in a large public school district in Texas.
The applicant pool was 67% women, 2% Asian, 45% Black, 10% Hispanic, and 38% White.
The study audited 11 LLMs, including models from OpenAI, Mistral, and Anthropic.
